title: Existence and uniqueness of the characteristic polynomial on a finite locally free module of constant rank
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$ an integer, $M$ an $A$-module and $\varphi:M\to M$ an $A$-linear map. Assume there are $f_1,\dots,f_r\in A$ generating the unit ideal such that for each $i$ the $A_{f_i}$-module $M_{f_i}$ is free of rank $n$. Then there is exactly one polynomial $\chi\in A[T]$ with the following property: for every ring map $A\to A'$ such that $M\otimes_AA'$ is a free $A'$-module of rank $n$, the image of $\chi$ in $A'[T]$ is the characteristic polynomial $\det(T\cdot1-\varphi_{A'})$ of $\varphi_{A'}=\varphi\otimes1$ on $M\otimes_AA'$ (computed in any basis). Moreover $\chi=T^n+c_{n-1}T^{n-1}+\dots+c_0$ with $c_k\in A$ (in particular $\chi$ is monic). In particular, if $M$ itself is free of rank $n$, then $\chi$ is the usual characteristic polynomial of $\varphi$.

lean.statement: theorem charpoly_locallyFree_exists_unique {A : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] {n r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A) (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤) (hfree : ∀ i : Fin r, ∃ e : Module.Basis (Fin n) (Localization.Away (f i)) (LocalizedModule.Away (f i) M), True) (φ : M →ₗ[A] M) : let P : Polynomial A → Prop := fun χ ↦ ∀ (A' : Type (max u w)) [CommRing A'] (ρ : A →+* A'), letI : Algebra A A' := RingHom.toAlgebra ρ; ∀ e : Module.Basis (Fin n) A' (A' ⊗[A] M), χ.map ρ = (LinearMap.toMatrix e e (φ.baseChange A')).charpoly; ∃ χ : Polynomial A, (P χ ∧ ∀ χ' : Polynomial A, P χ' → χ' = χ) ∧ (∃ c : Fin n → A, χ = Polynomial.X ^ n + ∑ k : Fin n, Polynomial.C (c k) * Polynomial.X ^ (k : ℕ)) ∧ ((Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) A M)) → ∀ e : Module.Basis (Fin n) A M, χ = (LinearMap.toMatrix e e φ).charpoly)
